alt: Changing the model in the middle of an ELU session: /model lists the models, the session changes from Opus to Sonnet, the next reply comes from Sonnet, and /agent change sets its effort to high.

frames.caption: Opus answered. You type /model to see the models.
You pick sonnet. The session's model changes.
Your next message goes to Sonnet.
The reply comes from Sonnet, in the same chat.
/agent change sets the effort of a model too.
From its next turn Sonnet works at high effort.
